brief: @buildthis.bisks.net make a website that will reveal something cool to us in exactly one week counting down and don’t let the cool thing be viewable in the code it has to be secret until you reveal what ever the very cool thing is
note: built chrysalis.bisks.net: a 7-day countdown. the reveal is AES-encrypted in the source and the worker won't even attempt to decrypt it until its own clock passes the target — nothing to find early, not even by reading the code.
